market.nav_basis: latest reported quarterly NAV, all 2026-06-30; no estimated current NAV used
market.definitions: discount_pct = 100*(1-close/reported_NAV). Positive means discount; negative means premium. Prices are unadjusted closes. S2 YTD uses first 2026 nonmissing observation per existing code.

s2.desc: (CCC-HY) OAS differential +2.04pp YTD; >=1.5pp = tail-specific repricing (confirming), <=0pp = contra

s3.desc: worst AI-exposed BDC discount (BXSL 2.9%) minus non-AI control median (1.4%) = +1.5pp; >=15pp = exposure-specific stress (confirming), <=5pp = inside normal sector dispersion (contra)

market.compound_reason: S2 confirms without BB flag; S3 is contra, so simultaneous S2/S3 confirmation fails.
